name: The Shade of Elura
summary: Elanaria sends young night elf warriors beneath Auberdine's waves to lay Elura to rest. They seek her medallion and Elunite ore for a weapon Smith Mathiel will forge.

sections.title: A Captain's Eternal Guard
sections.body: Long ago, a ship laden with rare Elunite ore struck rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse and sank. Its captain, Elura, cursed her own soul in despair and from unwavering duty. Bound to the wreck beneath the waves, her shade guards the lost cargo from anyone who would disturb it.

sections.title: Weapons of Elunite
sections.body: Elanaria sends young night elf warriors into Darkshore's surf to defeat Elura and recover her medallion and ore. Both are needed to put the captain to rest, and the metal goes to Smith Mathiel's forge. The trial tests their martial skill and respect for the fallen. It also provides ore for a crafted weapon.

faq.q: Who is the Shade of Elura?
faq.answer: Elura commanded an elven ship that wrecked in the shallows near the Auberdine lighthouse. In despair and from duty, she cursed her soul to guard its sunken cargo of Elunite ore.

faq.q: Why does Elanaria send warriors after Elura?
faq.answer: Elanaria sends warriors to defeat Elura, recover her medallion and ore, and put her spirit to rest. The trial tests their prowess and provides metal for a weapon.
The wreck lies underwater off Auberdine's coast in Darkshore. It is near the lighthouse and just south of the main harbor docks.

faq.q: What is Elunite ore used for?
faq.answer: Night elven smiths forge weapons from rare Elunite ore. Smith Mathiel in Darnassus uses the salvaged crates to make a personalized martial weapon for promising warriors.

faq.q: Does defeating the shade harm Elura permanently?
faq.answer: Defeating Elura breaks the curse binding her spirit to the sea floor. Elanaria says besting the captain in combat brings peace after her long vigil.

faq.q: Who crafts the weapon once the ore is collected?
faq.answer: After Elanaria receives the ore and medallion, she sends the warrior to Smith Mathiel in Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. He works the metal into an exceptional weapon.

angles.text: As a night elf warrior, you prove your grit in the water and your martial discipline. The trial earns you a forged Elunite weapon.
As a night elf, you honor a fellow kaldorei by laying Elura's shade to rest. Duty bound her beneath the waves for generations.
As a blacksmith, you see the night elves' craft in the potent armaments they make from blessed Elunite materials.
